title: A study of submillimeter methanol absorption toward PKS 1830‒211:. Excitation, invariance of the proton-electron mass ratio, and systematics
question: Constrain the excitation of submillimeter methanol absorption lines at z=0.89 toward PKS 1830-211 and test the cosmological invariance of the proton-electron mass ratio mu from the relative kinematics of the lines

data.bands: Bands 4, 5, 6, 7 (four tunings; B4 observed twice: B4a, B4b)
data.sensitivity: rms noise normalized to the continuum level, 1.0-1.7 x 10^-3 per tuning at 1.0-1.6 km/s resolution

what.value: Mu-sensitivity coefficients K_mu for each methanol transition

evidence.quote: Here, we adopt the $K_\mu$ values from (cite: jan11a)

what.value: Collisional rate coefficients for CH3OH with para-H2 used in RADEX

evidence.quote: we used the non-LTE radiative transfer code RADEX (cite: vdtak07) with collisional rate coefficients from (cite: pot04)

what.value: H2 column density of 2e22 cm^-2 (southwest) used as H2 proxy for abundance

evidence.quote: We further take the H$_2$ column density of $2 \times 10^{22}$ cm$^{-2}$, estimated by (cite: mul14a) using CH spectra (obtained in 2012), as an H$_2$ proxy.

what.value: H2 column density of 1e21 cm^-2 for the northeast line of sight

evidence.loc: 3.3 Non-detection of methanol on the northeast line of sight
evidence.quote: With an H$_2$ column density of $1 \times 10^{21}$ cm$^{-2}$ (cite: mul14a)
Rest frequencies are taken from the Cologne Database for Molecular Spectroscopy (cite: CDMS01; CDMS05; CDMS16)

recipe.goal: Calibrate and extract spectra toward SW and NE images
recipe.method: CASA standard calibration, phase-only self-calibration on continuum, conversion topocentric to LSRK then heliocentric, spectra extracted with UVMultiFit using a two-point-source model
assumptions: Two point sources adequately describe the data; third image and weak extensions have negligible effect on the spectra

recipe.goal: Assess quasar continuum variability and flux ratios
recipe.method: Continuum flux densities and ratios of the NE and SW images tracked across tunings; light curve reconstructed using a time delay and spectral index
key_parameters: time delay 27 days; spectral index alpha close to -0.7
assumptions: Light curve is smooth after the start of the observations

recipe.goal: Fit a common two-Gaussian opacity profile to all methanol lines
recipe.method: Joint fit of all transitions with a sum of two Gaussian velocity components shared by all lines, with per-tuning covering factor f_c, per-line opacity scaling gamma_i and per-line bulk velocity v_i; 13CH3OH opacities tied to 12CH3OH
key_parameters: Reference line: ground-state A-CH3OH (350.905 GHz) with gamma = 1
assumptions: Constant f_c as a function of velocity within a tuning
Errors Gaussian, parameters uncorrelated, model a good representation of the data

recipe.goal: Constrain methanol excitation with a RADEX non-LTE grid
recipe.method: RADEX models on a grid of n_H2 and Tkin (also G1 column density and A/E), compared to the ALMA spectra via chi2 summed over tunings; two Gaussian components treated as independent
key_parameters: Two B4 visits averaged, average f_c adopted; 13CH3OH modeled with ratio 62 but not in the chi2
assumptions: Para-H2 is the collisional partner; no additional heating by ambient radiation field or cosmic rays; T_CMB = 5.14 K

recipe.goal: Derive A/E ratio, methanol abundance and 12C/13C ratio
recipe.method: A/E from the RADEX grid; total column from summing A and E over G1 and G2 divided by an H2 proxy; 12CH3OH/13CH3OH from the tied opacity ratio in the joint profile fit
assumptions: H2 column density 2e22 cm^-2 from 2012 CH spectra used as a proxy, despite profile variations between 2012 and 2019

recipe.goal: Fit multivariate regression of line velocities for delta mu / mu
recipe.method: Weighted linear regression v_i/c = (dmu/mu)*K_mu + Gamma_t*t + Gamma_E*Elow + Gamma_0, with several variable combinations; rest-frequency uncertainties added quadratically
key_parameters: K_mu values from Jansen et al. 2011a; frequency and K_mu not used as simultaneous variables (Pearson r ~ 0.8)
assumptions: Gaussian errors; 3-sigma upper limit taken as three times the 1-sigma uncertainty

recipe.method: Replace K_mu with frequency in the regression; estimate f_c vs frequency and an upper limit on core shift; repeat regression separating A- and E-CH3OH
key_parameters: Core shift Omega ~0.8 mas GHz (from Marti-Vidal 2013) gives max core shift ~2 microarcsec across the campaign
assumptions: Absorbing gas has constant solid angle so 1/f_c traces continuum solid angle

recipe.goal: Upper limit on methanol column density toward the northeast image
recipe.method: Stack A- and E-CH3OH lines with Elow < 30 K (weights = inverse squared rms), derive integrated opacity upper limit, convert to column density under LTE with T_ex = T_CMB
key_parameters: alpha = 2.2e13 cm^-2 km^-1 s for the ground-state A-CH3OH line; A/E = 1
assumptions: LTE with Tex = TCMB; line width 20 km/s
